scripts.infra:staging:up: docker compose --env-file .env.staging -f infra/docker-compose.deploy.yml -f infra/docker-compose.staging.yml up -d --no-build --pull never --remove-orphans
scripts.infra:prod:up: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.deploy.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --no-build --pull never --remove-orphans
scripts.contracts:gen: pnpm --filter @cees/contracts generate:public && pnpm --filter @cees/contracts generate:ai-service && uv run --project apps/ai-service datamodel-codegen --input packages/contracts/openapi/ai-service.openapi.yaml --input-file-type openapi --output apps/ai-service/app/api/generated/models.py --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --target-python-version 3.14 --use-standard-collections --use-union-operator --use-default --collapse-root-models --disable-timestamp --extra-fields forbid --formatters black isort && uv run --project apps/ai-service python apps/ai-service/scripts/generate_openapi_artifact.py
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:gen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-client/src packages/ai-service-client/src/generated apps/ai-service/app/api/generated
